hypothesis_en: Two narrow boundary-execution clarifications on the frozen complete-context parent. Explicitly couple the already permitted generic marketing/category and short cookie-provider name slots to verified basis, harmless deltas and each native task loss fields; a truthful named-versus-unnamed provider difference or a bare terms heading alone does not add a processing practice or unseen obligation. Separately scope aggregate totals to the displayed catalog/result set when actual item inclusion and identical item facts are demonstrated; do not invent a cart/order/global inventory state from a Products/Filter/Total view. Retain actual extra items, conflicting item facts, bound subjects, liability parties, operational routes and real transaction/processing conditions. Earlier broad template additions regressed qualified form localization and stock-heading interpretation; this proposal adds no broad body-language or factual-truth restatement and leaves those existing rules intact. Preserve the complete reading context, original packet IDs, schema/enums/order, native contract, model, window, execution and validators.
